---
title: "A table of gravel styles"
editor: source
---

::: {.callout-note}
1. The classification was computed using a robust [k-means method](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K-means_clustering){target="_blank"}.
2. The classification is based on a frame size that fits a 175 cm high rider (generally frame size M or 54), according to manufacturer's charts.
3. All bikes with suspension are at 20% sag
:::

```{r setup-gravel-style, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE,
                      knitr.kable.NA = '')
source_path <- here::here("bike_geometry_project.R")
source(source_path)

```


```{r working}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true


keep_cols <- c("model", "kmeans_style", "terrain_class", "material",
               "handlebar", "fork_class", "udh", "dropout", "axle_spacing",
               "max_chainring_1x", "stealth_dropper", "mounts_fender", "mounts_rack_rear",
               "tire_width_max_700c", "tire_width_max_650b",
               "base_build_usd", "frameset_usd", "country")
style_table <- geobike[my_fit == TRUE, .SD, .SDcols = keep_cols]
setnames(style_table, old = "kmeans_style", new = "style")
style_table[, id := .I]
# Put the data into a SharedData object for crosstalk
#shared <- SharedData$new(dt)
style_table_shared <- SharedData$new(style_table, key = ~id, group = "style_table")

racy <- style_table[style == "racy"]
setnames(racy, old = "model", new = "Racy")
relaxed <- style_table[style == "relaxed"]
setnames(relaxed, old = "model", new = "Relaxed")
rowdy <- style_table[style == "rowdy"]
setnames(rowdy, old = "model", new = "Rowdy")
xtra_rowdy <- style_table[style == "xtra rowdy"]
setnames(xtra_rowdy, old = "model", new = "xtra_Rowdy")

# 2) Three pre-filtered SharedData objects (same group/key)
racy_shared    <- SharedData$new(racy,    key = ~id, group = "style_table")
relaxed_shared <- SharedData$new(relaxed, key = ~id, group = "style_table")
rowdy_shared   <- SharedData$new(rowdy,   key = ~id, group = "style_table")
xtra_rowdy_shared   <- SharedData$new(xtra_rowdy,   key = ~id, group = "style_table")

# Hide every column except the first (index 0). 0-based for DataTables:
hide_cols <- 1:(ncol(style_table) - 1)   # same as your ncm1

mk_dt <- function(sd_obj) {
  datatable(
    sd_obj,
    rownames = FALSE,
    selection = "none",
    options = list(
      searching  = TRUE,  # remove global search box
      dom        = "lrtip",       # remove the 'f' (filter box) from the toolbar
      pageLength = 100,
      columnDefs = list(
        list(targets = hide_cols, visible = FALSE, searchable = FALSE)  # <- note 'searchable'
      )
    )
  )
}

racy_col       <- mk_dt(racy_shared)
relaxed_col    <- mk_dt(relaxed_shared)
rowdy_col      <- mk_dt(rowdy_shared)
xtra_rowdy_col <- mk_dt(xtra_rowdy_shared)

# filters
filters <- list(
  filter_checkbox("class", "Type", style_table_shared, ~terrain_class, inline = TRUE),
  filter_checkbox("material", "Frame material", style_table_shared, ~material, inline = FALSE),
  filter_checkbox("handlebar", "Handlebar", style_table_shared, ~handlebar, inline = FALSE),
  filter_checkbox("axle", "Hub spacing", style_table_shared, ~axle_spacing, inline = FALSE),
  filter_checkbox("udh", "UDH", style_table_shared, ~udh, inline = TRUE),
  filter_checkbox("dropper", "Stealth dropper", style_table_shared, ~stealth_dropper, inline = TRUE),
  filter_checkbox("fork", "Suspension correction (mm)", style_table_shared, ~fork_class, inline = FALSE),
  filter_checkbox("sliding", "Sliding dropout (mm)", style_table_shared, ~dropout, inline = TRUE),
  filter_checkbox("fender", "Fender mounts", style_table_shared, ~mounts_fender, inline = TRUE),
  filter_checkbox("rack", "Rack mounts", style_table_shared, ~mounts_rack_rear, inline = TRUE),
  filter_slider("tire_700", "Max 700c tire width (mm)", style_table_shared, ~tire_width_max_700c, step = 1),
  filter_slider("tire_650", "Max 650b tire width (in)", style_table_shared, ~tire_width_max_650b, step = 0.05),
  filter_slider("max_chainring", "Max 1X chainring", style_table_shared, ~max_chainring_1x),
  filter_slider("frameset", "Frameset ($)", style_table_shared, ~frameset_usd),
  filter_slider("base_build", "Base Build ($)", style_table_shared, ~base_build_usd),
  filter_checkbox("country", "Location", style_table_shared, ~country, inline = TRUE)
  )

controls <- tagList(filters)   # <— turn the list into real UI elements

bscols(
  widths = c(2, 10),
  controls,                    # <— not the raw list
  bscols(
    widths = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
    racy_col, relaxed_col, rowdy_col, xtra_rowdy_col
  )
)

```
